capabilities: Open all files created in the last week
Configure how many days back to include
Run the review from a Start Review command
extras: A video walkthrough exists for installation and usage, but its content is not described in the README.
motivation: The author's weekly review process involves reviewing all files created that week, and opening them by hand was tedious.
problem: Manually finding and opening every file created during the past week is tedious when doing a weekly review.
summary: Weekly review helper that opens all files created within the last configurable number of days via a single command.
